messages.subject: Adding multiple users to application
parts:
Good Morning, 

I had an application up on shinyapps.io, and I was using the scrypt process to manage users. Is this process no longer valid? How can I batch authorize users to use the application? I have about 143 users and would prefer not to have to add them all individually through the GUI. 

Thanks, 

-Gordon

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Adding multiple users to application
parts:
Hi Gordon,
You are correct, the scrypt functionality is going to be stopped by Friday of this week. We are looking at modifying the shinyapps package to allow you to add users programmatically.  

How soon do you get this done?  It would be great if you could send me a short private note to tar...@rstudio.com with a feel for your use case.

Thanks Gordon,
Tareef
